name: r4_ursides_write_087
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
s=Path('src/URMatchingURRectangle.lean').read_text().replace('public import URMatchingRectangle','public import URMatchingRectangleSides').replace('ur_indexed_empty_rectangle','ur_indexed_empty_rectangle_sides').replace('      Disjoint A B ∧','      (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ i, x = e (Sum.inl i)) ∧\n      (∀ y ∈ B, ∃ i, y = e (Sum.inr i)) ∧\n      Disjoint A B ∧')
s=s.replace("  apply ordered_empty_rectangle (Fintype.card I) G e'",'''  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hleft, hright, hd, hempty⟩ :=
    ordered_empty_rectangle_sides (Fintype.card I) G e' (by
      intro i j hij hadj
      have hne : t.symm i ≠ t.symm j := fun h => hij (t.symm.injective h)
      have hh := ht _ _ ⟨hne, hadj⟩
      simpa using hh)
  refine ⟨A, B, hA, hB, ?_, ?_, hd, hempty⟩
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hleft x hx
    exact ⟨t.symm i, rfl⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hright y hy
    exact ⟨t.symm i, rfl⟩
/-''').replace('end URMatching','-/\nend URMatching')
# Remove superseded trailing proof text, rather than leave commented implementation.
s=s[:s.index('/-\n  intro i j hij hadj')]+ '\nend URMatching\n'
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingURSides.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
